description: This file defines the AppRouter class responsible for handling route generation and navigation in a Flutter application. It centralizes route definitions including static routes like '/lock' and '/home', and dynamic routes such as '/folder/:id' and '/doc/:id', with mechanisms for parsing path-like URLs and arguments. It also includes internal helpers for matching routes and extracting IDs, as well as an error screen for invalid routes.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Handles route generation for the app, supports static and dynamic routes with ID extraction and validation, and fallback error handling.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Main route generator that matches route names to widget screens, handling both static and dynamic routes with ID parsing.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Attempts to match a given path with a base route pattern and extract the ID part if present.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Extracts an integer ID from route path fragment or arguments provided during navigation.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates a route displaying an error message for invalid routes or IDs.
